_comment: Friendly-name -> Domo dataset GUID registry for the Upwork->Domo pipeline. Single source of truth shared between pipeline/upwork_to_domo.py and any downstream MCP tool that needs to reference a Domo dataset id. Same pattern as SpotSee/datasets.json. Populate the GUIDs by running scripts/bootstrap_domo_datasets.py once Domo + Upwork creds are both live (it will create the empty datasets and print their ids).

_provenance.upwork_contracts: Snapshot table. One row per engagement (active + closed). Replaced in full on each run. Keys: contract_id.
_provenance.upwork_time_logs: Event/append table. One row per logged hour-block. Append-only; dedupe on (contract_id, work_date, freelancer_id) downstream in Magic ETL.
_provenance.upwork_earnings: Snapshot table. Financial overview + recent transactions, refreshed in full each run.
_provenance.upwork_offers: Snapshot table. Pending + accepted/declined offers within trailing 90 days.
_provenance.upwork_messages: Optional. Append-only summary of message threads (room metadata + counts; no message bodies, to avoid PII in Domo).
_provenance.upwork_jobs_search: Optional. Saved-search results snapshot, for market-rate / category trend dashboards. Replace on run.
